text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was super fun!
I was running zoom-zoom fast!
choice_data_list: How was the atmosphere at today's race?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Atmosphere?
Hmm, isn't it the same as usual?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun!
Is there anything else~?

Being able to stay her usual self no matter what race lies ahead.
While I believe that is a strong weapon for Haru Urara...

Tension can sometimes produce great results.
So, I decided to suggest entering an even higher-level race—
choice_data_list: How about entering a G1 next?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's such a cool nameー!
Alright! I'll enter, I'll totally enterー!
If she enters a race where everyone is running seriously, it might just change Haru Urara's mindset!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
February... wait, what was that again?
I feel like I learned it, but I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanna run in the
"Febyubawwy Stakes"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Long names are so hard~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Feb-roo-ary, Feb... rary,
Felibury...? I don't get it anymoreee!

"...Our next target race has been decided.
However—"

Haru Urara doesn't seem to take things very seriously.
Just how far will she be able to go?
